item.title: MCP vs. API Explained: Do We Still Need APIs After MCP?
item.description: No. MCP doesn't replace APIs — it sits on top of them. An MCP server is, almost always, a thin adapter that calls a REST/GraphQL/gRPC API underneath and translates it into a shape an LLM can safely discover and call.
